title: Content Studio
description: An internal tool for a small software team. One prompt field gives you texts in two voices, and nothing reaches the calendar until a named person approves it.
problem: Drafts lived in documents and style lived in people's heads. Nobody could say where a text came from or who had signed it off.
system: You type a request. The app picks format, voice and sources, Claude writes, the draft is scored for SEO and GEO, and the approver for that voice decides.
artifact: A tested web app with Studio, Approvals, Content, Calendar, Sources and Settings. Google Workspace sign-in.
outcome: Working and tested in two days. Not live yet, and I have no business numbers yet.
